OverHistory.UPDCommentry:
WICKET! Shoaib Bashir bowling to Rishabh Pant, full length ball, pitching outside off stump, Rishabh Pant gently pushes it with soft hands towards short cover. It looks harmless, but Ben Stokes reacts in a flash. He charges in, picks up cleanly, and instead of going to the striker’s end as everyone expected, he fires a direct hit at the bowler’s end, and it’s bullseye! 

WICKET Rishabh Pant run out Ben Stokes (India 248 Runs for 4 wickets)

ANOTHER DAY, ANOTHER WICKET AT THE STROKE OF LUNCH AND WHAT A WAY TO GET THAT! Chris Woakes bowling to Nitish Kumar Reddy, short of good length ball, pitching outside off stump, on the channel, drawing Reddy on the defence, all he could manage is an outside edge, the ball carries to Smith and he takes a regulation catch! OverHistory.NewCommentry: Ben Stokes to Jasprit Bumrah Wicket
OverHistory.Commentry: Ben Stokes bowling to Jasprit Bumrah, short length ball, pitching outside off stump, Jasprit Bumrah plays an aggressive pull shot on the back foot WICKET Jasprit Bumrah c Sam Cook b Ben Stokes (India 147 Runs for 9 wickets) towards Mid-On
OverHistory.UPDCommentry:
STOKES GETS THE REWARD FINALLY! Ben Stokes bowling to Jasprit Bumrah, short length ball, pitching outside off stump, Jasprit Bumrah top-edges the pull, high in the air and Sam Cook settles under and takes a safe catch! He has hung around for too long, but finally Stokes gets the better of him! Bumrah has thrown away all the hard work, and they are nine down now! 

WICKET Jasprit Bumrah c Sam Cook b Ben Stokes (India 147 Runs for 9 wickets)

OH DEAR! SIRAJ HAS BEEN DISMISSED IN A  UNLUCKY FASHION AND ENGLAND WIN BY 22 RUNS! TEST CRICKET AT ITS BEST! Shoaib Bashir bowling to Mohammed Siraj, good length ball, pitching outside off stump, Mohammed Siraj defends it, but the ball spins after landing and rolls towards the stumps!
